pages.text: Steel is the heart of TFMG, but the machines that make it are built from simpler materials. This chapter covers everything you can make $(item)before your first steel ingot$():

$(li)$(item)Fireproof bricks$(), from fireclay.$(li)$(item)Cast iron$(), from iron and coal.$(li)$(item)Limesand$(), the flux of the blast furnace.$(li)$(item)Cement and concrete$().$(li)$(item)Sheets and alloys$() of lead and nickel.$(br2)$(l)Create machines you need$()

$(li)$(item)Crushing wheels$(), for limesand and crushed ores.$(li)A $(item)mechanical mixer$() over a $(item)basin$(), for fireclay, cement and concrete.$(li)A $(item)mechanical press$(): over a depot or belt it presses sheets, over a basin it compacts.
$(li)A $(item)blaze burner$() under the basin, lit with fuel, for the recipes marked $(item)heated$().$(br2)Click an item at the bottom of a page to see its exact recipe in JEI.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
